limits: Selected static views cannot certify every camera angle, transition/popping, FPS, 8GB operation or human driving feel.
A possible very thin residual road-edge line remains documented rather than claiming pixel-perfect geometry.
Blossom HLOD remains diagnostic only and was not promoted into these production captures.
